title: An explicit bound of twelve for cycle-edge decompositions
description: We prove that every finite simple graph admits an exact partition of its original edges into at most 12(|V(G)|-c(G)) simple cycles and singleton edges, with c(G) including isolated components. The proof establishes a weighted bound with singleton weight 23/42 using finite completion, a scale decomposition and a renewal potential. A Lean formalization and certificate artifact accompany the manuscript.
